sources.quote: QS-C-2025,SUP-C,conditional,2025-04-01,,PER-BIANCHI,QS-C-2023,no new parts until 8D-25-031 is closed and re-audit passed
A supplier with status conditional may not receive new parts.

findings.why: Meccanica Chisone is conditional (QS-C-2025 replaces the approved QS-C-2023). BR-225 would be a new part for it, and 8D-25-031 is still open.

sources.quote: A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: The approved supplier list covers BR-225 at PLT-BEI for CUST-AUR, and only SUP-B is approved there. SUP-C has no approval for this part, site and customer. The audit does not approve it for any part (QP-11 4.1).

sources.quote:
The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
after any of: a change of source, a change of material, a change of manufacturing process, or a change
of coating or surface treatment.
Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: BR-225 belongs to PRG-X, which is an Aurelia program. Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual replaces revision 3. It requires written approval (PPAP) before shipment after a change of source, and notification 90 days ahead. No approval is on file. Approval is per part number (7.3), so no existing approval for another part covers it.

sources.quote: Supplier: Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C). Opened 2025-03-20. Status: open.

cracks around fastening holes on brackets machined from EN AW-6082 material delivered by
the supplier

findings.why: SUP-C has an open 8D on EN AW-6082 material. BR-225 is made of EN AW-6082-T6. The suspected root cause is inconsistent ageing in the heat treatment, and corrective action is not verified.

sources.quote: SC-BR225-YS,BR-225,Yield strength Rp0.2 at least 250 MPa,250

findings.why: The drawing requires EN AW-6082-T6. SUP-C is qualified only for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5, and has no capability for 6082-T6. The typical yield of T5 is 230 MPa, below the 250 MPa minimum of SC-BR225-YS.

sources.quote: A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for the drawing material. Missing certificates are an open question for the supplier quality engineer.

findings.why: No 3.1 certificate from SUP-C for MAT-6082-T6 is on file. Open question for the supplier quality engineer, Elena Gallo (PER-GALLO).
